answer.justification: Only activation measurements are available. Relative L2 is 0.092 at layer 1, 0.179 at layer 8 and 0.191 at layer 16. It stays nearly flat to 0.201 at layer 24 and ends at 0.249 at layer 32, with a final-layer jump of +0.025 and onset layer 10. This matches the quantized profile. Cosine similarity of 0.968, effective rank of 4.14 (noise-like) and direction consistency of 0.520 also fit quantized. The mid-layer size ratio of 0.968 is exactly the quantized value, and the layer-2 spike of 0.2 is small. Fine-tuned is ruled out because its size ratio is above 1 (1.017–1.023), its direction consistency is higher (0.62–0.70) and its effective rank is lower. System-prompted is ruled out because its layer-2 spike would be 31.7 or more and its L2 would plateau near 0.4. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero.
